title: scenario
description: One recorded run of a trigger: the seed and generated input, the stubbed results of every effectful node, and the report the run produced. wilanis fuzz writes them; wilanis regress replays them and diffs node by node.

$schema.description: The kind of this document: its published schema URL, or the alias @wilanis/scenario.schema.json.

description.description: What this scenario covers, in one or two sentences, so a reader knows why the recording is kept.

label.description: A short human name for this document, shown wherever a reader sees it instead of its path. Absent: the file name stands in.

trigger.description: The trigger this run fired. A scenario replays a way in, not an implementation: the binding chosen under the profile decides which graphs actually run.

seed.description: The seed wilanis fuzz generated this run's input from, so the same input can be generated again.

in.description: The input the trigger was fired with, generated from the seed and recorded as it was.

request.description: The request the run read, for a trigger whose kind hands one; what fire.in and any policy read from.

stubs.description: dotted node path -> the value its operation returned.

expect.description: The report this run produced, which wilanis regress replays against and diffs node by node.

status.description: How the run as a whole ended: done, failed, or blocked by a policy or the guard.

output.description: What the run answered, recorded as it was.

nodes.description: What each node did, by its dotted path, so a replay says which node first differs.

handler.description: For a call or a map, the operation that ran, so a replay says when a node was rebound rather than only that its answer changed.

out.description: What this node answered, recorded as it was.

selected.description: For a switch, the rule it took, so a replay says when routing changed.
